title: Lai Evacuated to Fortified Command Center in Mock 'Decapitation Strike' Drill
detail: President Lai Ching-te was whisked by armored personnel carrier from his offices in Taipei to a fortified command center near the Ministry of National Defense on August 7, 2026, day three of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-fire exercise. Dubbed 'Wan Chun,' the drill simulates the evacuation of Taiwan's leader to a secure location in the event of war or a decapitation strike targeting the government's central command. Lai donned a flak jacket, received security briefings, and issued instructions during the exercise — the first time he has personally taken part, though predecessors Tsai Ing-wen and Ma Ying-jeou did so in prior years. Taiwan's presidential office said the exercise was designed to review command structure, inter-agency coordination, and emergency-response mechanisms so the government can keep operating during a crisis. The same day, Han Kuang 42 also featured tests of autonomous drone technology supplied by US firm Shield AI, and a visit from US Representative Michael McCaul (R-TX) delivering a message of Congressional support for Taiwan.
